After casting, your <style="accent-gn">Ice DMG</style> is increased for a period.

Courage
A key resource for unleashing Special Attacks and select Expertise Skills. Regenerates 3 points per second, with a starting maximum of 100.

Basic Attack: Windborne Grace
Executes a sequence of up to four attacks, dealing Attack DMG

Tips: Fill the gaps with Basic Attacks when Courage is too low for other offensive skills.

Raises the banner spear, granting Inspire to allies. Afterward, a follow-up leap can be launched, dealing Attack DMG to the enemies within range and knocking them airborne, while restoring 100 Courage.
Inspire: Lasts for 10s. During this time, all allies' Haste +10%. You restore 10 Courage per second and 1 stack of Sharp every 2s.
"Endless storm, unlock thy mighty power at my knight's command! Wind, reveal thy glory with a surging rush! Manifest in the wind!

Tips: Cast when Courage is low.

Converts Courage into a sustained wind field, dealing Attack DMG to nearby enemies until Courage runs out, using 16 Courage per second. The skill may be deactivated by clicking again.

Tips: Cast at full Courage and regain Courage during Valor Cyclone to extend duration.
Throws Dodder Seeds at the target, dealing <style="dendro">Forest DMG</style>. Each round launches 3 seeds, for a total of 5 rounds.

Channels for <style="accent-gn">6</style>s, summoning falling seeds every 0.5s to deal <style="magic">magic dmg</style> to nearby enemies. At the same time, heals up to <style="accent-gn">10</style> nearby allies (prioritizing teammates) and grants them <style="accent-gn">25%</style> DMG Reduction.

Imbues the power of fire, granting a Class Skills CD Boost and increased Haste while active.

Strategy: Use when Formless reaches A or S to maximize benefits during the burst window.

Let the passion surge again! Consumes 3 Performance Passion, reigniting the spirits of the weary. Performs a sequence of notes that restores HP to 10 allies within range (prioritizing teammates) and grants Tenacity Chord. Each stack of Tenacity Chord additionally increases Max HP by 0.5% (up to 2.5% Max HP) for 5s (duration cannot be refreshed once 5 stacks are reached).

Performance Passion: Required to perform music. Regenerates 1 stack every 5s.

Tips: Highest healing potential. Monitor your team's health to maximize efficiency and prevent overhealing.

Resonates with Airona's soul power. After a short chant, revives all Allies within 20 meters.
[Cannot be affected by the same type of effect within 100s]

Leaps forward and smash into the ground, dealing DMG to all enemies in an area based on your max HP.
Then gains Exaltation, granting yourself and allies Super Armor and DMG Reduction.

Conceals the caster's presence to prevent Aggro generation and cleanses all debuffs from the caster for 10s.

This skill is unaffected by CD effects.

Dispels debuffs from up to 10 allies within 25m (party members prioritized).

Summons Elite: Boarrier Tyrant to charge forward with tusks for 3s. Deals Attack DMG and knocks enemies airborne during the charge. Boarrier tusks tear through flesh, inflicting 100% Wound on enemies hit for 15s.
Upon the skill cast, the DMG dealt and healing of your Special Attack are increased for a period.
<style="accent-gn">Transforms into Elite</style>: Void Bzzar for a period of time, during which you can release stings and projectiles.

<style="accent-gn">Transforms into</style> Elite: Blackstone Vanguard to perform a spinning attack that deals Fire <style="physical">Attack DMG</style>. Every stack of Blade Intent allows for an additional spin (up to <style="accent-gn">15</style> stacks). This damage benefits from all types of elemental bonuses and is not affected by passive effects.

Summons Boss: Ridge Fang to deal Attack DMG.
After casting, instantly resets Survival Instinct CD. You remain Invigorated temporarily, and your Armor and Max HP are increased.

Summons Elite: Sanctuary Eye to deal Attack DMG.

Tosses a coin.50% chance to restore 10 HP; 40% chance to attract lightning and lose 10 HP; 10% chance to fully restore HP.
"A mysterious item from a certain continent!"

Consumes 10 HP to attack with a Pickaxe.
If the attack hits a Stalker, restores 50 HP.
Killing a Stalker fully restores HP.
Cannot be used when HP is insufficient.
The actual damage is calculated based on the Armor of the object the Stalker has transformed into.

33% chance to obtain Amber: Reduces all skill CDs by 0.5s;
33% chance to obtain Benitoite: Restores 50 HP;
33% chance to obtain Dragon Crystal: Fires 5 energy blades in all directions;
1% chance to obtain Fulgurite: Lightning strikes all Stalkers within 30m.
